verdict.rationale: Moneybird documents a path-versioned API (v2) with a commitment to equal behaviour per version, plus a dated changelog that diffs spec versions going back to 2014. That covers the versioning half of the story. The evidence explicitly says there is no standalone deprecation-policy document, so the deprecation-policy half is not delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, deprecation signaling) and independent corroboration of version-stability behaviour.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: By pointing to a specific version, we can make sure you always can expect equal behaviour from our API.
Moneybird maintains a dated, spec-diff API changelog (entries from 2014 through the present; each entry diffs two dated spec versions with per-endpoint changes
The spec carries dated versions (v2-<date>-<hash>) matching the published API changelog.
